title: Google Workspace Day-2 Administration & Operations Runbook (OU Design, Policy Governance & Runbooks)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace administration/governance/compliance).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Regulatory/compliance INTERPRETATION (CMMC assessment outcomes, NIST 800-171 applicability, ITAR/DFARS determinations, C3PAO assessment scheduling) is deferred to the organization's compliance/legal/assessor — the solution provides the technical control mapping, configuration method, and evidence, not the certification determination. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
